description: Client-facing RPC behavior and payment pathfinding cost on this node: request rates, response times and sizes, resource-limit warnings and drops, gRPC read-path load, and pathfinding request, compute, and discovery activity.

panels.title: RPC Request Rate
panels.description:
**What:** Rate of RPC requests handled, counting every HTTP and WebSocket call.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate of the RPC-requests counter over 5 minutes.
**Reading it:** Tracks client demand on the node.
**Healthy range:** workload-dependent.
**Watch for:** Sudden sustained spikes (client surge or abusive polling) or a drop to zero (endpoint unavailable).
**Source:** src/xrpld/rpc/detail/ServerHandler.cpp ServerHandler ctor

targets.expr: rate(xrpld_rpc_requests_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])

panels.title: RPC Response Time
panels.description:
**What:** P95 and P50 of end-to-end RPC handler time (full HTTP handling, not just command execution).
**How it's computed:** 95th and 50th percentiles over a 5-minute window.
**Reading it:** Lower is better; P95 shows the slow tail.
**Healthy range:** workload-dependent; most methods well under a second.
**Watch for:** Rising P95 while request rate is flat (expensive queries or contention).
**Source:** src/xrpld/rpc/detail/ServerHandler.cpp ServerHandler ctor

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(xrpld_rpc_time_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(xrpld_rpc_time_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])))

panels.title: RPC Response Size
panels.description:
**What:** P95 and P50 of RPC response payload size in bytes.
**How it's computed:** 95th and 50th percentiles over a 5-minute window.
**Reading it:** Larger responses cost more bandwidth and CPU to build.
**Healthy range:** workload-dependent.
**Watch for:** Large P95 (result-heavy queries such as broad account_tx, or API misuse).
**Source:** src/xrpld/rpc/detail/ServerHandler.cpp ServerHandler ctor

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(xrpld_rpc_size_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(xrpld_rpc_size_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])))

panels.title: RPC Response Time Distribution
panels.description:
**What:** RPC response-time spread shown as P50, P90, P95, and P99.
**How it's computed:** Four quantiles of response time over a 5-minute window.
**Reading it:** A wide gap between P50 and P99 signals a long latency tail.
**Healthy range:** workload-dependent; quantiles clustered together.
**Watch for:** P99 pulling far above P50 (bimodal latency or occasional very slow requests).
**Source:** src/xrpld/rpc/detail/ServerHandler.cpp ServerHandler ctor

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(xrpld_rpc_time_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(xrpld_rpc_time_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(xrpld_rpc_time_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(xrpld_rpc_time_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])))

panels.title: Pathfinding Fast Duration
panels.description:
**What:** P95 and P50 execution time of the fast pathfinding search (simplified, favoring speed over completeness).
**How it's computed:** 95th and 50th percentiles over a 5-minute window.
**Reading it:** Lower is better; fast pathfinding should stay quick.
**Healthy range:** workload-dependent; typically well below full pathfinding.
**Watch for:** Rising fast-path latency (pathfinding load or complex order books).
**Source:** src/xrpld/rpc/detail/PathRequestManager.h ctor

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(xrpld_pathfind_fast_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(xrpld_pathfind_fast_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])))

panels.title: Pathfinding Full Duration
panels.description:
**What:** P95 and P50 execution time of the full, exhaustive pathfinding search.
**How it's computed:** 95th and 50th percentiles over a 5-minute window.
**Reading it:** Full pathfinding is heavier and slower than fast mode.
**Healthy range:** workload-dependent.
**Watch for:** High or rising full-path latency (expensive path computation under subscription load).
**Source:** src/xrpld/rpc/detail/PathRequestManager.h ctor

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(xrpld_pathfind_full_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(xrpld_pathfind_full_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])))

panels.title: Resource Warnings Rate
panels.description:
**What:** Rate of resource-limit warnings raised when a peer or client exceeds its usage warning threshold.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate of the warn counter over 5 minutes.
**Reading it:** Occasional warnings are normal under load; a rising rate flags aggressive clients.
**Healthy range:** workload-dependent; low.
**Watch for:** A climbing warning rate (clients approaching limits, a precursor to drops).
**Source:** include/xrpl/resource/detail/Logic.h Logic::Stats ctor

targets.expr: rate(xrpld_warn_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])

panels.title: Resource Drops Rate
panels.description:
**What:** Rate of resource drops: consumers disconnected or blocked for excessive usage.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate of the drop counter over 5 minutes.
**Reading it:** Non-zero means the node is actively rejecting abusive connections.
**Healthy range:** at or near zero.
**Watch for:** Sustained non-zero drops (ongoing abuse or a misbehaving client/peer being throttled).
**Source:** include/xrpl/resource/detail/Logic.h Logic::Stats ctor

targets.expr: rate(xrpld_drop_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])

panels.title: gRPC Request Rate by Method (Spans)
panels.description:
**What:** Per-method gRPC call rate for the gRPC read API used by reporting and Clio.
**How it's computed:** Per-second count of gRPC calls grouped by method.
**Reading it:** Shows which gRPC methods are called and how often; only populated when the node serves gRPC.
**Healthy range:** workload-dependent.
**Watch for:** A single method spiking (heavy reporting load) or unexpected methods appearing.
**Source:** src/xrpld/rpc/GRPCServer.cpp (gRPC method handlers)

targets.expr: sum by (method, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", method=~"$grpc_method", span_name=~"grpc\\..*"}[5m]))

panels.title: gRPC Latency P95 by Method (Spans)
panels.description:
**What:** P95 latency per gRPC method.
**How it's computed:** 95th percentile of gRPC call duration per method over 5 minutes.
**Reading it:** Identifies slow gRPC read paths.
**Healthy range:** workload-dependent.
**Watch for:** One method's P95 rising (expensive ledger reads or backend pressure).
**Source:** src/xrpld/rpc/GRPCServer.cpp (gRPC method handlers)

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", method=~"$grpc_method", span_name=~"grpc\\..*"}[5m])))

panels.title: gRPC Error Rate by Status (Spans)
panels.description:
**What:** Rate of gRPC calls broken down by result status: success, error, resource-exhausted, failed-precondition.
**How it's computed:** Per-second count of gRPC calls grouped by status.
**Reading it:** Errors and resource-exhausted should be a small share.
**Healthy range:** workload-dependent; mostly success.
**Watch for:** Rising error or resource-exhausted rate (clients hitting limits or failing reads).
**Source:** src/xrpld/rpc/GRPCServer.cpp (gRPC method handlers)

targets.expr: sum by (grpc_status, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name=~"grpc\\..*", grpc_status!=""}[5m]))

panels.title: Pathfinding Compute Duration (Spans)
panels.description:
**What:** P95 and P50 of per-request path computation time.
**How it's computed:** 95th and 50th percentiles of path-computation duration over 5 minutes.
**Reading it:** Complements the fast/full timers with per-request visibility; populated under book/path RPC load.
**Healthy range:** workload-dependent.
**Watch for:** Rising compute time (complex paths or heavy pathfinding demand).
**Source:** src/xrpld/rpc/detail/PathRequest.cpp PathRequest::doUpdate

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="pathfind.compute"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="pathfind.compute"}[5m])))

panels.title: Pathfinding Request & Discovery Rate (Spans)
panels.description:
**What:** Rate of client path requests and of path-discovery passes.
**How it's computed:** Per-second count of path-request and path-discovery operations.
**Reading it:** Shows pathfinding demand and the discovery cost driver for subscription-heavy nodes.
**Healthy range:** workload-dependent.
**Watch for:** Discovery rate climbing (subscription load driving repeated path discovery).
**Source:** src/xrpld/rpc/handlers/orderbook/PathFind.cpp doPathFind; src/xrpld/rpc/detail/PathRequest.cpp PathRequest::findPaths

targets.expr: sum by (exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="pathfind.request"}[5m]))

sum by (exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="pathfind.discover"}[5m]))
